test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A hollow metal sphere of internal and external radii 5 cm and 6 cm, respectively, is melted into a solid cone of base radius 5.2 cm. What is the height (in cm, rounded off to 1 decimal place) of the cone?
solution:
**Given:**

A hollow metal sphere with internal radius = 5 cm and external radius = 6 cm is melted into a solid cone with base radius = 5.2 cm.

**Concept:**

The volume of the hollow sphere equals the volume of the solid cone.

**Formula Used:**

Volume of hollow sphere = (4/3)π(R³ - r³)

Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h

**Calculation:**

We have:

⇒ External radius (R) = 6 cm

⇒ Internal radius (r) = 5 cm

⇒ Base radius of cone = 5.2 cm

Volume of hollow sphere:

⇒ Vₛₚₕₑᵣₑ = (4/3)π(R³ - r³)

⇒ Vₛₚₕₑᵣₑ = (4/3)π(6³ - 5³)

⇒ Vₛₚₕₑᵣₑ = (4/3)π(216 - 125)

⇒ Vₛₚₕₑᵣₑ = (4/3)π(91)

⇒ Vₛₚₕₑᵣₑ = (364/3)π

Volume of cone:

⇒ V꜀ₒₙₑ = (1/3)πr²h

⇒ (364/3)π = (1/3)π(5.2)²h

⇒ 364 = (5.2)²h

⇒ 364 = 27.04h

⇒ h = 364 / 27.04

⇒ h ≈ 13.5

**∴ The height of the cone is 13.5 cm.**
